title: serves a purpose but won't buy again
text:
serves a purpose but won't buy again. instructions in Chinese only. Having said that, it's pretty self-explanatory with the pictures. The only issue I had was that I didn't put the side rack on before attaching the tabletop, so i was unable to fit it. I couldn't be bothered to start over, especially since I have little use for that part.
It's also about 3' off the ground with wheels attached, so it does not fit under my sofa or recliner.In fact, if you look closely at the picture, you will see the 4 casters on the ground next to the table, not attached.

It's decent enough but 2 stars for false advertising and questionable instructions.
